code_lines: ﻿/*EXTRAE PTMO NETO DE LA CTA FINANCIERA Y NO FINANCIERA DE HOGARES*/
WHEN T1.C_CUENTA='Financiera' THEN 'PTMO NETO CTA FINANCIERA'
WHERE (T1.SECTOR=T2.C_SI) AND (T1.C_SCN='B.9' AND T2.C_SI_SCN_N1='S.14') AND t1.'AÑO'n>2002
/*EXTRAE PTMO NETO DE LA CTA FINANCIERA DE HOGARES SIN AF71*/
('PTMO NETO CTA FIN AJUSTADO') AS ID

WHERE (T1.SECTOR=T2.C_SI) AND ((T1.C_SCN='B.9' AND T2.C_SI_SCN_N1='S.14' AND T1.C_CUENTA='Financiera' AND t1.'AÑO'n>2002) OR (T1.C_SCN='AF.71' AND T2.C_SI_SCN_N1='S.14' AND T1.C_CUENTA='Financiera' AND T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND t1.'AÑO'n>2002))
/*IMPUTA PTMO NETO AJUSTADO EN TABLA VARIABLES*/
PROC SQL;/*DISCREPANCIA TRIMESTRAL ENTRE PTMO NETO AJUSTADO DE CTA FIN Y PTMO NETO CTA CAPITAL*/
WHEN T1.ID='PTMO NETO CTA CAPITAL' THEN T1.DATO
WHERE T1.ID IN('PTMO NETO CTA CAPITAL','PTMO NETO CTA FIN AJUSTA')
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(2,4) AND T1.AÑO=2015 THEN (T1.DATO*1.095/4)
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(1,3) AND T1.AÑO=2015 THEN (T1.DATO*1.005/4)
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(1) AND T1.AÑO=2016 THEN (T1.DATO*1.02/4)
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(2) AND T1.AÑO=2016 THEN (T1.DATO*1.12/4)
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(3) AND T1.AÑO=2016 THEN (T1.DATO*1.025/4)
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(4) AND T1.AÑO=2016 THEN (T1.DATO*1.055/4)
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(3) AND T1.AÑO=2018 THEN (T1.DATO*1.02/4) /*CIERRE 2019*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(2) AND T1.AÑO=2018 THEN (T1.DATO*1.18/4) /*CIERRE 2019*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(4) AND T1.AÑO=2018 THEN (T1.DATO*1.105/4) /*CIERRE 2019*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(1) AND T1.AÑO in (2018) THEN (T1.DATO*0.95/4) /*CIERRE 2019 y 2020*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(1) AND T1.AÑO=2020 THEN (T1.DATO*0.95/4) /*CIERRE 2020*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(2) AND T1.AÑO=2020 THEN (T1.DATO*1.27/4) /*CIERRE 2020*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(3) AND T1.AÑO=2020 THEN (T1.DATO*0.9/4) /*CIERRE 2020*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(4) AND T1.AÑO=2020 THEN (T1.DATO*1.1/4) /*CIERRE 2020*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(3) AND T1.AÑO=2017 THEN (T1.DATO*0.95/4) /*CIERRE 2021*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(2) AND T1.AÑO=2017 THEN (T1.DATO*1.01/4) /*CIERRE 2021*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(1) AND T1.AÑO=2017 THEN (T1.DATO*0.9/4) /*CIERRE 2021*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(4) AND T1.AÑO=2017 THEN (T1.DATO*1.15/4) /*CIERRE 2021*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(1,3) AND T1.AÑO=2019 THEN (T1.DATO*0.9/4)
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(2) AND T1.AÑO=2019 THEN (T1.DATO*1.055/4)
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(4) AND T1.AÑO=2019 THEN (T1.DATO*1.105/4)
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(1) AND T1.AÑO=2021 THEN (T1.DATO*1.1/4) /*estaba en 1*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(2) AND T1.AÑO=2021 THEN (T1.DATO*1.05/4)
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(3) AND T1.AÑO=2021 THEN (T1.DATO*1/4)
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(4) AND T1.AÑO=2021 THEN (T1.DATO*1.25/4)/*estaba en 1.2*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(1) AND T1.AÑO in (2024) THEN (T1.DATO*1.005/4) /*cierre 2024*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(2) AND T1.AÑO in (2024) THEN (T1.DATO*1.105/4) /*cierre 2024*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(3) AND T1.AÑO in (2024) THEN (T1.DATO*1/4)/*cierre 2024*/
WHEN T1.TRIM IN(4) AND T1.AÑO in (2024) THEN (T1.DATO*1.09/4)/*cierre 2024*/
FROM TABLAS.BD_CTSI t1, TABLAS.T_SECTORIZACION T2,PERIODOS T3
WHERE (T1.SECTOR=T2.C_SI) AND (T1.C_SCN='P.4' AND T2.C_SI_SCN_N1='S.14') AND t1.'AÑO'n>2002 AND (T1.AÑO=T3.AÑO)
PROC SQL;/*SUMA ANUAL DE DISCREPANCIA ENTRE PTMO NETO AJUSTADO DE CTA FIN Y PTMO NETO CTA CAPITAL*/
WHEN T1.ID='PTMO NETO CTA CAPITAL' THEN T1.DATO*-1
WHERE T1.ID IN('PTMO NETO CTA CAPITAL','PTMO NETO CTA FIN AJUSTA')
WHERE (T1.SECTOR=T2.C_SI) AND (T1.C_SCN='D.42' AND T2.C_SI_SCN_N1='S.14' AND t1.'AÑO'n>2002 AND T1.C_ENTRADA='H')
PROC DATASETS; /*JUNTA AMBAS TABLAS PARA CALCULAR REFERENCIA FINAL*/
DROP TABLE PERIODOS, WORK.PN_S_AF71, WORK.DIF_PTMO_NETO, WORK.DIV_ANUAL,DIF_PTMO_NETO_T;
/*GRAFICO COMPARATIVO DE PTMO NETO ANTES DE AJUSTAR DIVIDENDOS*/
DATA=VARIABLES (WHERE=(ID IN ('PTMO NETO CTA CAPITAL','PTMO NETO CTA FIN AJUSTA','DIF PTMO NETO') ) KEEP=PERIODO ID DATO )
Legend2 CBORDER=WHITE POSITION = (BOTTOM CENTER OUTSIDE) MODE=reserve LABEL=NONE;
PLOT DATO* PERIODO=ID/VAXIS=AXIS1 HAXIS=AXIS2 hminor=1 FRAME	LEGEND=LEGEND2 ;
